 News On AIR | 
 October 24, 2026 8:45 PM 
 Union Home Minister Amit Shah chairs security review meeting in Delhi
 Union Home Minister Amit Shah today chaired a security review meeting at the Delhi Police Headquarters.
 Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta and senior officials of the Delhi Police were present at the meeting
